Class AbstractCrossTableBatchWriteBuilder<S extends AbstractCrossTableBatchWriteBuilder<S>>

java.lang.Object
dev.hogwai.dynamodb.simplified.builder.base.AbstractCrossTableBatchWriteBuilder<S>
Type Parameters:
S - the concrete builder type (for fluent chaining)
Direct Known Subclasses:
AsyncCrossTableBatchWriteBuilder, CrossTableBatchWriteBuilder
public abstract class AbstractCrossTableBatchWriteBuilder<S extends AbstractCrossTableBatchWriteBuilder<S>> extends Object
Abstract base for sync and async cross-table batch write builders.

Manages operations (put and delete), consumed capacity settings, and request item building shared across sync and async variants.
